CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    source text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source text PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id text,
    signal text,
    unit text,
    register text,
    scale double precision
);

CREATE TABLE machines (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    process_type text,
    production_type text
);

CREATE TABLE stations (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id text,
    processing_time_s double precision,
    availability_pct double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    power_working_kw double precision,
    power_idle_kw double precision
);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity double precision,
    before text,
    after text
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text,
    reason_code text,
    duration_s double precision,
    energy_kwh double precision
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text,
    tag text,
    value double precision
);

-- Populate tag_map with sensor mappings from requirements
INSERT INTO tag_map (tag_id, machine_id, signal, unit, register, scale) VALUES
('temp', 'M1', 'температура', 'градусы', 'temp_sensor_1', 1),
('temp', 'M2', 'температура', 'градусы', 'temp_sensor_2', 1),
('temp', 'M3', 'температура', 'градусы', 'temp_sensor_3', 1),
('pressure', 'M1', 'давление', 'бар', 'pressure_sensor_1', 1),
('pressure', 'M2', 'давление', 'бар', 'pressure_sensor_2', 1),
('humidity', 'M1', 'влажность', '%', 'humidity_sensor_1', 1),
('humidity', 'M2', 'влажность', '%', 'humidity_sensor_2', 1),
('humidity', 'M3', 'влажность', '%', 'humidity_sensor_3', 1);

-- Populate machines table with machine types
INSERT INTO machines (id, process_type, production_type) VALUES
('M1', 'ковка', 'сталь'),
('M2', 'горячее прокат', 'сталь'),
('M3', 'холодное прокат', 'сталь');

-- Populate stations table with processing details
INSERT INTO stations (id, machine_id, processing_time_s, availability_pct, mttr_s, power_working_kw, power_idle_kw) VALUES
('M1', 'M1', 600, 95, 300, 100, 20),
('M2', 'M2', 450, 90, 250, 80, 15),

-- Populate buffers table with buffer details
INSERT INTO buffers (id, capacity, before, after) VALUES
('B0', 50, 'source', 'M1');

-- Create views to expose typed fact tables over raw_ingest
CREATE VIEW events_view AS SELECT T1.ts, T1.machine_id, T1.reason_code, T1.duration_s, T1.energy_kwh FROM raw_ingest AS T1 INNER JOIN jsonb_each(T1.payload) AS T2 ON T2.key = 'events' AND T2.value::jsonb->>'type' = 'event';

CREATE VIEW samples_view AS SELECT T1.ts, T1.machine_id, T1.tag, T1.value FROM raw_ingest AS T1 INNER JOIN jsonb_each(T1.payload) AS T2 ON T2.key = 'samples' AND T2.value::jsonb->>'type' = 'sample';
